Generate UX Case Studies

Source: R/ux_case_study.R
ux_case_study.Rd

Generates contextualised educational case studies using usability testing data.

Usage

ux_case_study(data = NULL, domain = "ecommerce", level = "beginner")

Arguments

data

A usability dataset. If NULL, the function automatically selects the dataset associated with the domain.

domain

The digital product context: "ecommerce", "banking", "education", or "e-government".

level

Exercise difficulty: "beginner", "intermediate", or "advanced".

Value

A list containing the case study context, usability results, recommendations, and learning activities.

Examples

ux_case_study()
#> $title
#> [1] "UX Case Study: Online shopping platform"
#> 
#> $domain
#> [1] "ecommerce"
#> 
#> $level
#> [1] "beginner"
#> 
#> $organisation
#> [1] "An online retail company"
#> 
#> $product
#> [1] "Online shopping platform"

#> $scenario
#> [1] "The company wants to improve its online shopping experience and reduce difficulties during the product discovery and purchasing process."
#> 
#> $challenge
